title: Bank moves 40 AI pilots into production
article_text: Chief information officer Dana Reyes said, “We moved 40 pilots into production this year.” The bank expects further rollouts. Analysts at Example Research noted that most pilots stall.

title: Regulators publish AI audit guidance
extract: The regulator said firms must keep an audit trail for model decisions. Firms have until March to comply.

title: Survey: governance lags adoption
extract: A survey of 300 enterprises found that 62% have no AI governance owner. Respondents cited unclear accountability.

title: Vendor cuts inference prices
extract: The vendor cut inference prices by a third. A spokesperson, Lee Park, said "customers asked for predictable costs" in a statement.

title: CFOs say AI costs fell faster than planned
article_text: Finance chief Maria Soto told analysts, “We didn’t expect costs to fall this fast.” She said the company will reinvest the savings in data quality. Two other firms reported similar trends.

title: Retailer pauses agent rollout after errors
extract: The retailer paused its customer-service agent rollout after a pricing error. The company said it will resume once controls are in place.

title: Study: skills gaps slow enterprise AI projects
extract: A study of 120 large employers found that skills gaps were the most common cause of delay. Training budgets rose 18% year on year.

title: Consumer gadget maker unveils smart toaster
extract: The company unveiled a toaster with a touchscreen. It goes on sale next month.
